name: E-book Reader
description: Read EPUB, PDF, TXT, MOBI, AZW3, DOCX, comics and more in 18 formats, with paged, double-page and scrolling layouts, text-to-speech, translation, highlights and notes. Books and notes are written to a real folder on your disk through a bundled native sidecar.
releaseNotes: First public release: 18 book formats, paged/double-page/scrolling layouts, text-to-speech, translation, highlights and notes, real on-disk library via native sidecar, in-app folder picker for the library location.

zh-CN.name: 电子书阅读器
zh-CN.description: 支持 EPUB、PDF、TXT、MOBI、AZW3、DOCX、漫画等 18 种格式，单页 / 双页 / 滚动三种排版，可听书、翻译、划线与记笔记；通过随包提供的原生后端把书籍与笔记真正写入本机磁盘目录。
